answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on Llama, Qwen, and Mistral due to their competitive performance and widespread adoption.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates on instruction-following, reasoning, and code-related tasks using zero-shot or few-shot setups, which involve natural language generation outputs.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate model performance, we report normalized zero-shot or few-shot accuracy on the LM-Harness benchmark.
